title: Matsara
desc: When a rich businessman's daughter marries a factory worker, he tries to break them up by killing his son-in-law. Years later, his grandson decides to seek revenge for his father's murder.

title: Autograph Please
desc: A man contracts HIV because of an affair with a bar girl prior to his wedding. However, he decides to live normally and encourages other HIV patients to brave the ordeal.

title: Raghu Thatha
desc: A wish to fulfil her terminally ill grandfather's last desire and her stance against patriarchy place Kayalvizhi Pandian between conflicting choices, as she struggles to make the right decision.

title: Kona
desc: Narayana and his prophetic robot discover a remote village bound by an age-old sacrificial rite. Soon, he uncovers a sinister secret trapping the villagers in an endless cycle of past and present.

title: Kurukshetra
desc: After losing to the Kauravas in a gamble, the Pandavas go into exile. Upon their return, conflict arises over the dynastic succession leading to a war.

title: Shakthi
desc: Sakthi dreams of becoming a superhero. His wish unexpectedly comes true when the girl he is helping secure college admission dies due to unforeseen circumstances.
